source_note: Original career navigation inventory authored for AI Career Navigator. Inspired by John L. Holland's RIASEC vocational framework (1959), adapted under CC0 Public Domain dedication without copying proprietary question banks.
title: Comprehensive RIASEC Career Interest Inventory
description: A 30-item psychometric inventory assessing vocational interest dimensions: Realistic, Investigative, Artistic, Social, Enterprising, and Conventional on a 5-point Likert scale (1=Strongly Disagree, 5=Strongly Agree).

questions.text: I enjoy assembling, repairing, or troubleshooting mechanical devices and electronic hardware.
I prefer hands-on outdoor physical tasks rather than sitting at a desk all day.
I like building physical prototypes, woodworking, or using tools to craft objects.
I get satisfaction from understanding how engines, machinery, or electrical systems function.
I strongly dislike practical DIY tasks that involve manual tools or physical construction.
I enjoy solving complex mathematical puzzles and examining statistical trends.
I find it fascinating to conduct experiments and test scientific theories systematically.
I like analyzing root causes of problems using empirical data and logical deductions.
I spend free time reading scientific research papers, technology deep-dives, or exploratory studies.
I get impatient when asked to analyze raw datasets or dive deeply into abstract academic theory.
I enjoy expressing ideas through visual design, digital media, creative writing, or music.
I like brainstorming unconventional, imaginative solutions without rigid boundary rules.
I value creative self-expression, color theory, and aesthetic polish in products and presentations.
I enjoy designing intuitive user interfaces, digital graphics, or aesthetic layouts.
I prefer following strict standardized templates rather than inventing original creative styles.
I find fulfillment in mentoring, teaching, or coaching others to help them learn and succeed.
I enjoy resolving interpersonal conflicts and facilitating collaborative group discussions.
I am drawn to community service, peer counseling, or volunteering initiatives.
I actively listen when peers share personal challenges and offer empathetic guidance.
I prefer working in total isolation rather than interacting closely with team members.
I enjoy pitching ideas, persuading stakeholders, and leading project teams.
I am motivated by entrepreneurial challenges, business strategy, and ambitious targets.
I like organizing public events, marketing campaigns, or student club initiatives.
I take initiative in decision-making and negotiations during high-stakes situations.
I avoid taking leadership responsibilities or negotiating terms during group decisions.
I like organizing spreadsheets, categorizing data, and maintaining accurate records.
I enjoy creating structured workflows, checklists, and step-by-step documentation.
I value precision, regulatory compliance, and attention to detail in financial or operational tasks.
I feel comfortable following systematic, predictable schedules and quality standards.
I find maintaining orderly records and double-checking operational details tedious.
